dipole_torque_resolution — DRIVE tactorque op

• Datenarten: matrix × matrix × scalar × scalar × scalar × scalar × scalar → table

• Aufruf: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.dipole_torque_resolution(pts, u, sigma_px: 'float', pitch: 'float', coef: 'float', area: 'float', radius: 'float', trials: 'int' = 100, window=None, seed: 'int' = 0, form: 'str' = 'divergence') -> 'dict' (die Implementierung direkt: import tactorque; tactorque.dipole_torque_resolution(pts, u, sigma_px: 'float', pitch: 'float', coef: 'float', area: 'float', radius: 'float', trials: 'int' = 100, window=None, seed: 'int' = 0, form: 'str' = 'divergence') -> 'dict'; aus dem Register: opsdrive.get("dipole_torque_resolution"))

Verwendung

> Für diesen Operator gibt es noch keine Übersetzung. Es folgt der Originaltext unverändert.

マーカー重心の雑音 σ [px] を変位に足して双極子を trials 回取り直し、トルク分解能 σ_M = σ_D/|coef| [N·m] を測る。返り sigma_D (2,)、sigma_M (2,)、D0(雑音なし)、snr = |D0|/σ_D、trials。σ_M ∝ σ(実測)。Raises ValueError: σ < 0、trials < 2、coef = 0。
